thread:
Elaine: Reminder 7: OptiCart POC kickoff tomorrow 10am PST. Key asks: security questionnaire status, pricing for a 2-week Dedicated trial, and an eval plan for cart recommendation prompts. Need owners for each.

Raj: I can own evals + prompt templates. Need sample logs and expected QPS. Do they have anonymized sessions we can use?

Elaine: They said ~200k events for the POC dataset. I'll upload a sample CSV to the kickoff folder in ~20m.

Maria: Security questionnaire is half-done. Open items: SSO type (SAML/OIDC), KMS integration for keys, and whether inference logs leave their VPC. Security flagged any request to store prompts outside their VPC.

Tom: Pricing note: 2-week Dedicated -> recommend short reserved plan + burst addon. If they want p50 <100ms we need different GPU sizing. I'll draft a numbers slide.

Raj: Proposed eval buckets: relevance (nDCG@10), latency (p50/p95), safety/hallucination (manual spot-check on 100 examples). Prompt example: "Given session context and cart items, return 3 complementary product suggestions with one-line reason."

Elaine: Stakeholders attending: OptiCart - Priya (Head ML), Omar (Platform), Leah (PM). Our team: Elaine (AE), Raj (SE), Maria (CS), Tom (Solutions). Confirm?

Priya: Confirmed for OptiCart side. We'll have anonymized sample logs and a list of KPIs (CTR lift, add-to-cart rate).

Jenny-Bot: Calendar invite created: "OptiCart POC Kickoff" 10:00am PST. Link: https://meet.redwood.ai/opticart-poc

Maria: For tomorrow I'll bring the partial questionnaire and options for SSO/KMS. Also need to confirm whether customer allows debug logging of prompts. That changes privacy wording.

Raj: Quick checklist for the call: intros + success criteria (5m), data & access (10m), eval plan & prompts (10m), infra sizing & perf SLOs (10m), security Qs (10m), next steps/owners (5m).

Elaine: I'll prepare a 3-bullet success criteria doc: 1) nDCG@10 improvement > 0.40 vs baseline, 2) p95 latency < 800ms end-to-end, 3) no PII in outputs. Dropping in drive now: https://drive.redwood.ai/opticart/poc-kickoff

Tom: Also propose fallback policy: if Dedicated capacity is constrained, auto-fallback to hosted smaller model with tracing enabled. Keeps UX stable.

Maria: I'll confirm logging permissions with Priya on the call and update the questionnaire after.

Elaine: Thanks team. If you have slides/numbers drop them in the folder. See you tomorrow :thumbsup:
